hero.title_zh: 从图纸或样品到量产，99% 的线束我们都能做
hero.title_en: From drawing or sample to mass production — we can build 99% of wiring harnesses
hero.subtitle_zh: 汽车诊断线 · 重卡J1939 · 特斯拉/新能源 · 定制线束。OEM/ODM 工厂直供，支持按图纸、样品或针脚定义开模定制。
hero.subtitle_en: Automotive diagnostic cables, heavy-duty J1939, Tesla/EV and custom harnesses. OEM/ODM factory-direct, tooled from drawings, samples or pinouts.

custom_intro.title_zh: OEM/ODM 定制线束，我们按你的需求造
custom_intro.title_en: OEM/ODM Custom Harnesses — Built to Your Specification
custom_intro.desc_zh: 不管你是要一根还是十万根，只要有图纸、样品、接口图或针脚定义，我们就能匹配接口、设计工艺并量产。汽车、重卡、新能源、医疗、机器人、家电、办公设备、高铁动车…我们都能做。
custom_intro.desc_en: One piece or a hundred thousand — send us a drawing, sample, connector photo or pinout, and we'll match connectors, define the process and produce in volume. Automotive, heavy-duty trucks, EV, medical, robotics, appliances, office equipment, rail… we build them all.

features.desc_zh: OBD2、Deutsch、DB15、RJ45、Type-C、XT系列、安德森及客户指定接口。
features.desc_en: OBD2, Deutsch, DB15, RJ45, Type-C, XT series, Anderson and customer-specified connectors.

features.desc_zh: 按针脚定义、诊断协议和设备接口要求制作。
features.desc_en: Built according to pin definition, diagnostic protocol and equipment interface requirements.

features.desc_zh: 线长、线规、芯数、屏蔽、外被材料和分支结构均可调整。
features.desc_en: Length, wire gauge, core count, shielding, jacket material and branching can all be adjusted.

features.desc_zh: 中性包装、客户标签、型号贴纸、条码和说明书。
features.desc_en: Neutral packaging, buyer labels, model stickers, barcodes and instruction sheets.

steps.desc_zh: 图纸、样品、接口图、针脚定义或目标设备型号。
steps.desc_en: Drawing, sample, connector photos, pinout or target device model.

steps.desc_zh: 确认接口型号、接线方式、材料规格与可行性。
steps.desc_en: Confirm connector type, wiring route, material spec and feasibility.

steps.desc_zh: 制作样品，用于匹配、导通和功能验证。
steps.desc_en: Sample made for fit, continuity and function testing.

steps.desc_zh: 样品确认后量产，出货前可按批次全检。
steps.desc_en: Mass production after approval, batch inspection before shipment.

apps.title_zh: 覆盖各行各业的线束需求

factory.desc_zh: 超斯迈尔科技成立于2019年，位于深圳观澜，是一家专业生产汽车连接线、新能源储能线束、防水连接线及汽车诊断线的高新技术企业。拥有线束加工与电子开发中心，采用AMP、Molex、JST、KET、TE等品牌连接器，先后为道通科技、朗仁科技等知名企业配套服务。
factory.desc_en: Founded in 2019 in Shenzhen Guanlan, Super Smile is a high-tech manufacturer of automotive wiring, new-energy/storage harnesses, waterproof connectors and diagnostic cables. With our own harness processing and electronics development center, we use AMP, Molex, JST, KET, TE connectors and have supplied Autel, Launch and other well-known brands.
factory.clients_zh: 合作客户：道通科技、朗仁科技、TTI、深圳科列、贝斯新能源等
factory.clients_en: Clients include: Autel, Launch, TTI, Kelie, BESS New Energy and more

footer_about_zh: 深圳市超斯迈尔科技有限公司——专业线束与汽车诊断线制造商，支持OEM/ODM定制。
footer_about_en: Shenzhen Super Smile Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. — professional wiring harness and automotive diagnostic cable manufacturer, OEM/ODM custom supported.

blocks.text_zh: 工厂直供、接口匹配精准、支持小批量打样与OEM/自有品牌包装。出货前100%导通与外观检验，UL/RoHS/SVHC合规认证，长期稳定供货。
blocks.text_en: Factory-direct supply, precise connector matching, low-MOQ samples and OEM/private-label packaging. 100% continuity & appearance inspection before shipment, UL/RoHS/SVHC compliant, stable long-term supply.

blocks.text_zh: 提供图纸/样品/接口图 → 工程确认 → 7个工作日打样 → 批量生产。清晰接口图和针脚信息可大幅减少样品修改时间。
blocks.text_en: Send drawing/sample/connector photos → engineering review → samples in 7 working days → mass production. Clear connector photos and pinouts greatly reduce sample revision time.
